description: P5F-42 parity allowlist: observable differences between the legacy Dart pipeline (AnkiImporter + AnkiDeckAssembler) and the official-first pipeline (official saga + projection service) that are accepted by design. Anything outside this list fails the parity test.

entries.summary: Unit/lesson grouping differs: legacy uses AnkiOrganizationResolver smart grouping, official uses deck-path + unit::/lesson:: tag heuristics.
Official projection emits exactly one presentation kind per card (CardPresentationPolicy); the legacy assembler may emit multiple drills.

Vocabulary counts may differ in either direction: official rows exist only for cards with a usable term/translation pair (subset of cards), while the legacy adapter materializes vocabulary only for structured card kinds. Hard invariant: at most one official row per card.
The official path writes no anki_imports rows, no NoteStore, and no Turna SRS states by design (official collection owns scheduling).
Card-id-level equality between pipelines requires the real rslib import (host CI job with TURNA_ANKI_LIB); the fake engine mints sequential ids, so this harness compares counts and cardinality only.
